title: Lis' "Time Today": A Fresh and Energetic Start to the New Year
htmlContent:
Lis, the rising artist from North Jersey, started the new year with a bang with his latest single, "Time Today." After taking a break from music in 2019, Lis is back and better than ever, and this new release proves just that.

"Time Today" is a high-energy, fast-paced track that showcases Lis' impressive rapping skills and infectious flow. The beat is heavy and hard-hitting, complementing Lis' aggressive lyrics perfectly. With lines like "I ain't got no time today, I'm on my grind, and I won't be late," Lis clarifies that he's not messing around and is focused on his craft.

This new release is just the beginning for Lis in 2023, and fans can expect even more exciting music from the talented artist. Lis is poised to become a significant player in the rap game with his polished skills and versatility. "Time Today" indicates Lis is here to stay and is not slowing down anytime soon.
